resources.string: This MVP is not ready for real sensitive conversations. Its libsignal-based protocol integration has not had an independent security review.
No phone number and no address book upload. A cryptographic identity will be created only for this device.
A copied code can stay in the clipboard or keyboard history (the Samsung keyboard keeps it). Showing the QR code in person, or Share, is safer.
Scan a secure invitation QR code
Development delivery endpoint for this device. For a physical phone on the same Wi-Fi network, enter the laptop LAN address.
Emulator LAN default: http://10.0.2.2:8787. Physical LAN example: http://192.168.1.45:8787. Public tunnel example: https://example-relay.example.
HTTP relay is permitted only in this debug build for local Wi-Fi testing. It does not protect network metadata or transport integrity.
Insecure HTTP relay is blocked in release builds. Enter an HTTPS relay URL.

On a physical phone, 127.0.0.1 and localhost point to the phone itself, not your laptop. Use the laptop Wi-Fi address, for example http://192.168.0.87:8787, or keep 127.0.0.1 only over a USB cable with adb reverse tcp:8787 tcp:8787.
0.0.0.0 is valid for a server listening on all interfaces, but it is not a client address. On a physical phone, use the laptop Wi-Fi address, for example http://192.168.0.87:8787.
Public relay / tunnel mode uses an HTTPS URL that both the phone and emulator can reach.
HTTP is allowed only for debug LAN testing.
For tests across different networks, use an HTTPS relay URL.
Background synchronization is best effort and may be delayed by Android power management.
This action deletes the local profile, messages, contacts, and protocol keys from this device. The data cannot be recovered.
Debug-only test reset deletes the local profile, contacts, messages, invitations, and all protocol keys and sessions. The saved Relay URL is kept for repeated LAN testing.

This is a destructive debug action. It permanently deletes the local test profile, messages, contacts, invitations, protocol keys, sessions and pending delivery from this device. The saved Relay URL remains. Continue only when you intend to restart the test.
Show this code to the person you want to chat with. It can be used once and expires in 24 hours. Anyone who photographs it can send you a request, so check the safety number before you accept.
Compare these digits with your contact in person or over another trusted channel. If they differ, do not continue.
Tap the round button to show your invitation or to add a contact. Pull the list down to check for new messages.
Ask your contact to show their invitation and scan it, or paste the code they sent you. Then give them a name; only you see it.
Ready: the invitation is on the delivery server and can be scanned.
The invitation did not reach the delivery server. The code does not work until it is sent.
It is not known whether the invitation is on the delivery server. If your contact cannot find it, send it again.
Your invitation was used or has expired. Each invitation works only once: create a new one for the next person.
If nothing happens for a long time, someone else may have used this invitation before you. Ask the person for a new one, ideally in person.
Before you accept, compare the safety number with this person.

Ask the person to open the chat with you on their phone and tap your name at the top: they see the same 60 digits there. Compare all of them, in person or over a call you trust. Anyone who saw your invitation, even in a photo, can send a request under any name; only matching numbers show that it is really them.

Compare these 60 digits with the number on your contact\'s phone (in their contact request, or on this page in their app), in person or over a call you trust. If they differ, do not use this chat: ask for a new invitation in person.
You confirmed that this number matches the one on your contact\'s phone. The mark stays on this phone only.
New messages and contact requests. The text of messages is never shown.
Someone wants to start a chat. Compare the safety number before you accept.

Turn on notifications to see when someone writes to you. They show who wrote, never the text. On a locked phone Android shows only “New message”, unless you chose to show all notification content on the lock screen.
Blocks screenshots and screen recording of the app and hides its content in the list of recent apps.

On. They show who wrote, never the text; a locked phone shows only “New message” unless you chose to show all notification content on the lock screen. New messages are fetched in the background about every 15 minutes or later.
Off. You see new messages only when you open the app.
No messages yet. Write the first one.
Waiting for the other person to accept
This invitation code is not valid.
This invitation uses an unsupported version.
This invitation no longer works: someone has already used it, it has expired, or it never reached the delivery server. Ask for a new one.
This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
Request sent. Waiting for the other person to accept.
The relay could not be reached.
Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
Sending is blocked for this contact.
This build is not for messaging
Chats are available only in test (debug) builds until the new protocol has had an independent security review. This build does not send or receive messages.

This version replaced the old prototype protocol with the new end-to-end protocol. Old test chats, contacts, and their keys were deleted on purpose and cannot be restored or reused. Pair with your contacts again using a new invitation.
Data on this phone cannot be read

The key that protects your conversations on this phone is missing or no longer matches them. This can happen after the key storage of the phone was reset. The messages, contacts and keys stored here cannot be decrypted again, and nothing was sent or received without the key. To use the app again, delete the local data and create a new profile. Your contacts will need a new invitation from you and will see a new safety number.
Data is not available right now
The secure key storage of the phone or the local database did not respond. Nothing was deleted. Check again; if this keeps happening, restart the phone.
Your contacts can no longer reach this phone

The secret of this phone\'s inbox on the delivery server is missing or damaged, while your chats are still here. Messages sent to you can no longer be fetched, and a new inbox would stay unknown to your contacts, so nothing was sent or received. To use the app again, delete the local data and create a new profile; your contacts will need a new invitation from you.
Delete local data and start over

The delivery server now protects each inbox with a secret, so only its owner can read or delete waiting messages. Old test chats could not move to the new inboxes and were deleted on purpose; your profile stays. Pair with your contacts again using a new invitation.
Did you get the file I sent yesterday?
I will call you around noon.
A short sound when you send a text and when one arrives in a chat that is open. Silent when the phone is on silent or vibrate.

The contact, its keys and all messages are deleted from this phone. The other person is not told: what they send afterwards will not arrive. To write to each other again, you will need a new invitation.
The messages are deleted from this phone. Messages still being sent stay until they are sent. The other person keeps their own copy.
The permanent notification while the app checks for new messages
Every 30 seconds. You can turn it off in Settings.

While the app is closed, it checks for new messages every 30 seconds, so notifications come quickly. Android then shows a permanent notification, and the phone uses more battery, more so on mobile data.
Working in the background is allowed: Android will not put the app to sleep.
Android may put the app to sleep, and messages then arrive late.
Some phones (Xiaomi, Redmi and others) also need “Autostart” turned on for the app in the phone’s own settings.
Hold to record a voice message, release to send
Allow the microphone in the phone’s settings to record voice messages
The recording is on its way
Slide up to keep recording without holding
The recipient will be able to play the message only once.
Tap to make the message one-time.
This voice message can only be played once.
The recipient can play this voice message only once.
Only the selected part will be kept, and the recording will go on after it.
Your contacts will appear here. Show your invitation or add a contact from theirs.
Your profile exists only on this phone: no server knows your name.
Are you sure you want to delete this message?
Are you sure you want to delete these messages?
Theme, wallpaper, swipe in the chat list
New messages within half a minute
Choose the action that a left swipe on a chat performs in the chat list.
Deletes the profile, contacts, messages and keys from this phone. You will be asked to confirm first.
Do you know what time it is?
